title: Sign in
subtitle: Use your Google or Facebook account. The first time, your account is created automatically.
legalNote: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
unavailableTitle: We could not load the sign-in options.
unavailableDetail: Check your connection, turn off content blockers and try again.
errorGeneric: We could not sign you in. Please try again in a moment.
errorInvalidGoogleToken: We could not confirm your Google account. Please try signing in again.
errorInvalidFacebookToken: We could not confirm your Facebook account. Please try signing in again.
errorProviderDisabled: This way of signing in is unavailable right now. Try the other one.
errorProviderUnavailable: The provider did not respond. Please try again in a moment.
errorEmailNotProvided: Facebook did not share your email. Sign in with Google, or allow email access when signing in with Facebook.
errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists, created with another provider. Sign in with the provider you used before.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
inviteTitle: {{name}} invited you to their account on Vera
inviteRoleOwner: Role: Owner. An owner can do everything, including the plan and the people.
inviteRoleEditor: Role: Editor. An editor changes the portfolio and the spending.
inviteRoleViewer: Role: Viewer. A viewer can only look.
inviteSignInWith: Sign in with the Google account of {{email}}. The invite only works for that e-mail.
inviteOtherAccount: You are in another account. Sign out to accept the invite.
inviteErrorInvalid: This invite expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
inviteErrorEmailMismatch: Sign in with the account of {{email}}, the address that got the invite.
inviteErrorAccountNotEmpty: You already have a Vera account with data. To join this one, export and delete yours in Settings › Data and privacy, or ask for an invite to another e-mail.
offerSignIn: Sign in with Google to redeem it. The offer works for a new account or a Free account that was never Premium.
offerOwnerOnly: Only the account owner redeems the offer. Ask the owner to open this link.
offerRedeemed: Offer redeemed. The details are in Plan and usage.
offerNotRedeemed: You are in, but the offer was not redeemed. {{reason}}
offerErrorNotFound: This link is no longer available. Ask for a new link.
offerErrorNotOwner: Only the account owner redeems the offer.
offerErrorEmailUsed: This e-mail already had a free trial. The trial is once per e-mail.
offerErrorEmailUnverified: The trial without a card needs an e-mail verified by the sign-in provider. Sign in with Google.
offerErrorTooMany: Too many offers redeemed from this address today. Try again tomorrow.
offerErrorAlreadyPaid: This account already subscribed to Premium. The offer is only for accounts that never subscribed.
offerErrorTrialUsed: This account already had a Premium trial. Each account gets one trial.
offerErrorAlreadyRedeemed: This account already redeemed an offer. Each account redeems one.
offerErrorNotEligible: This account cannot redeem the offer. It works for a new account or a Free account that was never Premium.
